chunks: It was narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I said to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام: "Can a man depart early before the Day of Tarwiyah by a day or two because of the crowding and the pressure of the people?" He said: "There is no harm in it."

key_terms.التَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah in the hajj rites
key_terms.ضِغَاطِ: pressure and compression caused by crowds
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يَتَعَجَّلُ: to hasten or go earlier than usual

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to go early to Mina before the Day of Tarwiyah because of crowding?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to hajj travel arrangements. It indicates that leaving for Mina one or two days before the Day of Tarwiyah, due to crowding and congestion, is permissible.
